t.Water alone cannot remove grease because: Ruwa kadai ba zai iya cire maiko ba saboda mai da ruwa ba sa haduwa. Surfactant (gajeren wakili mai aiki na saman) kwayar halitta ce mai iyakoki biyu. Ƙarshen ɗaya yana son ruwa. Daya karshen son mai. Lokacin da kuka wanke, ƙarshen mai son mai yana turawa cikin maiko kuma ƙarshen masu son ruwa ya tsaya a cikin ruwa. Tare da shafa, man zaitun yana shiga cikin ƙananan ɗigon ruwa waɗanda ke kewaye da surfactant, don haka suna ta iyo a cikin ruwan kurkura maimakon su koma baya.
t.Surfactants are grouped by the electric: Ana tattara abubuwan da ke sama ta hanyar cajin lantarki akan ƙarshen ƙaunar ruwa. Za ku yi amfani da rukunoni uku a cikin wannan kwas:
t.**Anionic** (negative charge): LAS, made: Anionic (cajin mara kyau): LAS, wanda aka yi daga acid sulphonic, da SLES (ana siyar dashi azaman "texapon"). Ƙarfafa masu tsaftacewa da masu kumfa mai kyau. Tushen kayan wanki da kayan abinci.
t.**Nonionic** (no charge): alcohol ethoxy: Nonionic (babu caji): barasa ethoxylates kamar darajar AEO-9. Mai kyau a kan ƙasa mai laushi, ƙananan kumfa, kuma har yanzu suna aiki a cikin samfurori na acid da kuma kusa da masu lalata.
t.**Cationic** (positive charge): benzalko: Cationic (tabbatacciyar caji): benzalkonium chloride (BKC), fili ammonium quaternary da ake amfani da shi azaman maganin kashe cuta. Mai rauni mai tsabta, amma yana kashe ƙwayoyin cuta da yawa.
t.Opposite charges cancel each other: Zarge-zarge masu gaba da juna sun soke juna
t.Anionic and cationic surfactants attract: Anionic da cationic surfactants suna jan hankalin juna kuma suna samar da hadaddun m, gizagizai wanda baya aiki da kyau. Kada a taɓa BKC a cikin ruwa mai ruwa ko wankan wanki da aka yi da LAS ko SLES. Za ku ga wannan da idanunku a Darasi na 3.3.
t.The **pH scale** runs from 0 to 14. Pure: Ma'aunin pH yana gudana daga 0 zuwa 14. Ruwa mai tsabta shine 7 (tsaka tsaki). A ƙasa 7 shine acid; sama da 7 shine alkaline. Kowane mataki yana da ƙarfi sau goma fiye da na kusa da shi, don haka pH 2 ya fi acidic sau goma fiye da pH 3. Za ku auna pH tare da takarda takarda (mai arha, mai kyau don farawa) ko nau'in pH mai nau'in alkalami (mafi daidai, yana buƙatar calibration).

t.Cleaning experts describe four forces th: Kwararrun tsaftacewa sun bayyana runduna huɗu waɗanda ke aiki tare, galibi ana zana su azaman da'irar: sunadarai (samfurin), aikin (shafewa, tashin hankali, fesawa), zafin jiki (ruwan dumi yana narkewa da sauri) da lokaci ( tsawon lokacin da samfurin ya tsaya akan datti). Idan wani karfi ya sauka, dole ne wani ya hau. Wankin otal mai ruwan zafi da inji yana buƙatar ƙarancin sinadarai fiye da macen da take wanke hannu a cikin ruwan rijiyar sanyi.

Lokacin da kuka ba da shawarar jiƙa da ƙazantattun tufafi, kuna ƙara lokaci. Kyakkyawan kwatance wani ɓangare ne na samfurin.
t.**Hard water** is the other thing to kno: Ruwa mai wuya shine sauran abin da za a sani. Magungunan kashe kwayoyin cuta suna aiki mafi kyau akan saman da aka riga an tsaftace su, saboda datti yana garkuwa da ƙwayoyin cuta kuma yana amfani da sinadarin da ke aiki. A cikin wannan darasi za ku yi na'ura mai tsafta bisa tushen benzalkonium chloride (BKC), wani fili na ammonium quaternary ("quat") wanda ake amfani da shi sosai a cikin magungunan kashe-kashe.

Yi amfani da matakin in-amfani da lokacin tuntuɓar da aka bayyana akan takardar bayanan fasaha na mai siyarwar ku don maganin kashe saman ƙasa, kuma rubuta su a cikin takardar ku.
